name: singlet_dim_reduction_contrastive_target_embedding
title: Contrastive target-specific embedding against a background
description: Isolates structure specific to target cells by contrasting them with background cells measured on the same genes. The default method, contrastivevi, fits a count model with a shared background latent and a target-only salient latent; cpca scans a linear contrast on a log grid. Needs raw counts with target and background groups in obs. Do not use for batch correction (use integration tools) or when no background group exists.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Embedding method; contrastivevi is the default, cpca is the closed-form linear contrast.

groups.description: Obs column and values that mark target and background cells.

group_key.description: Obs column holding each cell's group label.

target.description: Value of group_key for target cells.

background.description: Value of group_key for background cells.

n_hvg.description: Highly variable genes shared by all methods; 2000 is a proposed default.

contrastivevi.description: Options used when method is contrastivevi.

n_salient.description: Dimension of the target-only salient latent.

n_background.description: Dimension of the shared background latent.

n_hidden.description: Hidden width of the encoders and decoder.

wasserstein_penalty.description: Weight of the background salient penalty; 0 leaves the split to the KL terms.

batch_key.description: Optional obs column used as a covariate.

max_epochs.description: Training epochs, fixed in advance rather than set by convergence.

cpca.description: Options used when method is cpca.

contrast_min.description: Smallest contrast value on the log grid.

contrast_max.description: Largest contrast value on the log grid.

contrast_count.description: Number of log-spaced contrast values scanned; the silhouette-best is kept.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for training and for k-means in contrast selection.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/contrastive_salient. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_target, n_background, n_hvg, setting (selected contrast or latent sizes) and selection_criterion. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
